_comment: Claude Desktop → OmniMind. PREFERRED: Claude Desktop shares Claude.ai's connector list — add the hosted server once as a custom connector (see claude-ai-connector.md); no claude_desktop_config.json edit is needed. LEGACY (stdio): merge mcpServers.omnimind-personal into ~/.config/claude/claude_desktop_config.json (Linux) or ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (macOS). It runs the server in-process as agent claude-desktop-josh (josh-personal, rw, sourceWeight 0.85). OMNIMIND_MCP_AGENT_KEY is the omk_ key printed by keygen for THIS agent (sent as x-agent-key); OMNIMIND_API_KEY is the shared service key. OMNIMIND_MCP_USER_ID is optional: the user the omnimind:// resources read as; tools always take userId explicitly.

hosted_connector.name: OmniMind
hosted_connector.scopes_recommended: memory:read (add memory:write after a week of dogfooding)
